cases.title: Billed quantity exceeds GRN-accepted quantity after a partial rejection
cases.purpose: Probes the quantity leg of the three-way match. The GRN received the full ordered quantity but REJECTED part of it, so allowed_qty must come from qty_accepted (not qty_received, not PO qty). The bill claims the full ordered quantity, so it must be trimmed to the accepted quantity and qty_over_grn (REVIEW) raised, forcing REVIEW_REQUIRED. Critically, amounts must STILL be computed (only a BLOCKER nulls net_payable). A clean second line guards against over-trimming.

cases.title: Supplier bills BELOW the PO price - pay the lower price, INFO only
cases.purpose: The mirror of E02 and the sharpest discriminator in this set. When the billed unit price is LOWER than the PO price we keep the billed price and pay less, raising price_under_po (INFO). Because nothing is cut, there is NO adjustment, so the recommendation must be plain CLEAR, not CLEAR_WITH_ADJUSTMENTS - an implementation that treats any price mismatch as an adjustment, or that 'corrects' the price upward to the PO price (inflating what we owe), fails here. The PO is in partially_billed status to confirm that state is still checkable and does not raise po_not_open.
